paragraphs.label: Coding and Calendar:
paragraphs.text: Letters may shift (+1, −2) or be replaced by their alphabet position (BOOK = 2-15-15-11). Example: DOG → BME means each letter moves back 2, so CAT → AYR. Calendar: divide the number of days by 7 and move forward by the remainder. 100 days after Wednesday: 100 ÷ 7 leaves 2, so Friday.

ai.title: Coding and Calendar
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga pattern ng pagpapalit ng letra at pagbibilang ng araw.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hanapin ang shift sa pagitan ng unang salita at coded na anyo nito.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Sa calendar, ang remainder lang ang mahalaga.

paragraphs.text: Children of siblings are cousins. Example: Ana is Ben's daughter, Ben is Carla's brother, Carla is Dan's mother, so Ana and Dan are cousins. For analogy, find the relationship in the first pair and apply it to the second: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : School (worker and workplace).

ai.title: Blood Relations and Analogy
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Relasyon ng pamilya at ng mga salita.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Gumuhit ng family tree; sa analogy, pangalanan ang relasyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Mga karaniwang relasyon: worker–workplace, tool–use, part–whole.

ai.title: Gabay sa Figures and Patterns
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang figures and pattern questions ay non-verbal reasoning — gumagamit ng hugis, simbolo, at visual arrangements.

🔍 Breakdown
Pitong uri:
• Rotation — umiikot sa angle
• Reflection — mirror image
• Size Progression — lumalaki/lumiliit
• Element Counting — dumarami ang elements
• Shape Alternation — paulit-ulit na shapes
• Position Movement — gumagalaw sa grid
• Missing Figure — tukuyin ang kulang

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Obserbahan kung paano nagbabago ang figure sa bawat step. I-check: direksyon, size, bilang ng elements, position, at repetition.

📦 Halimbawa
• Rotation: UP → RIGHT → DOWN → LEFT (90° clockwise)
• Mirror: → ← (horizontal reflection)
• Counting: 1, 3, 5, 7 dots (+2)
• Alternation: Circle → Square → Triangle → Circle → Square → Triangle

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Test ng visual-spatial intelligence at pattern recognition. Madalas sa CSE Analytical Ability.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Tingnan ang direksyon, laki, bilang ng elements, at posisyon. I-count ang lines, dots, at shapes.

🎯 Exam Tip
Sa rotation, i-check kung clockwise o counterclockwise at gaano kalaki ang angle. Sa mirror, i-check kung horizontal o vertical ang flip. Pagkakasunod-sunod ng pag-check: (1) bilang ng elements, (2) laki, (3) posisyon o rotation, (4) shading o kulay.
ai.prompt: Explain figures and pattern questions in simple Tagalog — rotation, reflection, size, counting, alternation, position, and missing figure — with CSE exam tips.

ai.title: Kahulugan ng Figures and Patterns
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Non-verbal reasoning na gumagamit ng hugis at visuals sa halip na words o numbers.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Sinusukat nito ang pattern recognition at spatial reasoning — kakayahang makita ang changes sa figures.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hindi kailangan ng math — observation lang.
ai.prompt: Explain what figures and pattern questions are and why they are used.

paragraphs.text: Figures and pattern questions are forms of non-verbal reasoning that involve analyzing shapes, symbols, diagrams, and visual arrangements instead of relying mainly on words or numerical calculations. These questions test your ability to recognize visual patterns, identify changes in shapes, understand spatial relationships, and predict the next figure based on a specific rule.

ai.title: Ano ang Figures and Patterns?
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang figures and pattern questions ay non-verbal reasoning gamit ang shapes, symbols, at visual arrangements.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Sinusukat nito: pattern recognition, spatial relationships, at prediction ng susunod na figure.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hindi kailangan ng computation — observation lang.
ai.prompt: Explain this definition with examples of visual pattern recognition.

ai.title: Mga Uri ng Figure Patterns
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pitong karaniwang pattern: rotation, reflection, size, counting, alternation, position, at missing figure.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Bawat isa ay may unique clue: rotation (angle), reflection (flip), size (grow/shrink), counting (add/remove), alternation (repeat), position (move), at missing (complete).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
I-check isa-isa ang bawat possibility — direksyon, laki, bilang, posisyon.
ai.prompt: Explain the seven types of figure patterns with examples.

paragraphs.label: 1. Rotation Pattern:
paragraphs.text: A figure changes its direction or orientation by rotating at a consistent angle.

ai.title: Rotation Pattern
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang figure ay umiikot sa consistent angle (90°, 180°, 45°, etc.).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
I-check kung clockwise o counterclockwise ang ikot.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang 90° clockwise ay: UP → RIGHT → DOWN → LEFT.
ai.prompt: Explain rotation patterns with examples.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: A triangle points UP, then RIGHT, then DOWN. Which direction comes next? Solution: The triangle rotates 90° clockwise each time. UP → RIGHT → DOWN → LEFT. Answer: LEFT

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Rotation
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano naging LEFT ang susunod?
Sagot: 90° clockwise rotation: UP → RIGHT → DOWN → LEFT. Sunod ng DOWN ay LEFT.
ai.prompt: Explain step by step how to solve this rotation pattern.

paragraphs.label: 2. Reflection or Mirror Image:
paragraphs.text: A figure is flipped horizontally or vertically, creating its mirror image.

ai.title: Reflection / Mirror Image
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang figure ay binaliktad (flip) — either horizontally (left-right) o vertically (up-down).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Horizontal flip: kanan → kaliwa. Vertical flip: taas → baba.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Tingnan kung anong axis ang flip — horizontal ba o vertical?
ai.prompt: Explain reflection patterns with examples.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: If an arrow points to the right and is reflected horizontally, which direction will it point? Solution: The arrow will point to the left. Answer: LEFT

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Reflection
ai.content:
Tanong: Bakit LEFT ang sagot?
Sagot: Horizontal flip (mirror sa gitna): ang arrow na pakanan ay magiging pakaliwa.
ai.prompt: Explain step by step how horizontal reflection works.

paragraphs.label: 3. Size Progression:
paragraphs.text: Shapes gradually increase or decrease in size according to a pattern.

ai.title: Size Progression
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang shapes ay lumalaki o lumiliit sa bawat step.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Obserbahan kung dumarami ba ang laki (growing) o bumababa (shrinking).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
I-check ang ratio ng sizes — palaging doble ba, o pare-pareho ang dagdag?
ai.prompt: Explain size progression patterns.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: Small circle → Medium circle → Large circle → ? Answer: A larger circle, following the same increasing pattern.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Size Progression
ai.content:
Tanong: Bakit larger circle ang sagot?
Sagot: Patuloy na lumalaki ang size bawat step. Kaya sa susunod, mas malaking circle pa.
ai.prompt: Explain how to continue this size progression pattern.

paragraphs.label: 4. Element Counting Pattern:
paragraphs.text: The number of objects or elements increases or decreases in each figure.

ai.title: Element Counting
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang bilang ng objects/elements ay dumarami o bumababa sa bawat figure.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
I-count ang dots, lines, o shapes — may pattern (+2, +3, ×2, etc.).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
I-check kung constant ba ang dagdag o pattern (1, 3, 5, 7 = +2).
ai.prompt: Explain element counting patterns.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: Figure 1: 1 dot. Figure 2: 3 dots. Figure 3: 5 dots. Figure 4: ? Solution: The number of dots increases by 2 each time. 1, 3, 5, 7. Answer: 7 dots

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Element Counting
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano naging 7 dots ang susunod?
Sagot: Constant +2 dots bawat figure: 1, 3, 5, 7. Kaya 7 dots.
ai.prompt: Explain step by step how to solve this element counting pattern.

paragraphs.label: 5. Shape and Symbol Alternation:
paragraphs.text: Different shapes or symbols appear in a repeating sequence.

ai.title: Shape Alternation
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang shapes ay paulit-ulit sa pattern (cycle).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
I-identify ang cycle: Circle → Square → Triangle → (repeat).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hanapin ang cycle length — 2 shapes ba, 3 shapes, o 4?
ai.prompt: Explain shape alternation patterns.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: Circle → Square → Triangle → Circle → Square → ? Answer: Triangle

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Alternation
ai.content:
Tanong: Bakit Triangle ang sagot?
Sagot: Cycle ng 3 shapes: Circle, Square, Triangle. Kaya pagkatapos ng Circle → Square, susunod ay Triangle.
ai.prompt: Explain how to find the next shape in this alternation pattern.

paragraphs.label: 6. Position and Movement Pattern:
paragraphs.text: An object changes its position within a box, grid, or diagram according to a specific direction or sequence.

ai.title: Position and Movement
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang object ay gumagalaw sa loob ng grid/box base sa direction at sequence.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
I-track ang path: gumagalaw ba clockwise? Counterclockwise? Diagonal?

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
I-check kung may step pattern ang movement (1 position ba, 2 positions, etc.).
ai.prompt: Explain position and movement patterns.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: A dot moves from the upper-left corner to the upper-right corner, then to the lower-right corner. Where will it move next if it follows a clockwise pattern? Answer: Lower-left corner.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Position Movement
ai.content:
Tanong: Bakit lower-left ang sagot?
Sagot: Clockwise movement: upper-left → upper-right → lower-right → lower-left. Cycle ito ng 4 positions.
ai.prompt: Explain step by step how to solve this position movement pattern.

paragraphs.label: 7. Missing Figure:
paragraphs.text: A figure contains an incomplete section, and you must identify which shape or symbol correctly completes it.

ai.title: Missing Figure
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
May kulang na bahagi sa figure, at kailangan mong tukuyin kung anong shape/symbol ang kumukumpleto.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Tingnan ang pattern ng iba pang sections — dapat mag-follow ng rule.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
I-check ang symmetry at repetition — madalas ito ang key.
ai.prompt: Explain missing figure problems with a clear method.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: A square is divided into four equal sections. Three sections contain circles, while one is empty. The task is to identify which missing arrangement follows the pattern of the other sections. Answer: Depends on the given diagram and its visual rule.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Missing Figure
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano sasagutin ang missing figure problem?
Sagot: Tukuyin kung anong symmetry o pattern ang nire-follow ng 3 sections. Pagkatapos, yung tamang shape/symbol ang ilalagay sa empty section.
ai.prompt: Explain how to solve missing figure problems step by step.

Kapag may dalawang pagbabago, hanapin ang bawat isa nang hiwalay.

Isang sistematikong paraan para sa mga figure series.

Isa-isahin ang bawat posibleng pagbabago.

Madalas may dalawang pagbabago nang sabay.

Mga grid na may nawawalang figure.

Alamin kung anong simbolo ang kulang sa hilera at hanay.

Suriin ang parehong hilera at hanay.

ai.title: Gabay sa Philippine Constitution
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang 1987 Philippine Constitution ay ang pinakamataas na batas sa Pilipinas. Dito nakasaad ang mga pangunahing prinsipyo ng ating pamahalaan, ang kapangyarihan at tungkulin ng bawat sangay nito, at ang mga karapatan at kalayaan ng mga mamamayan.

🔍 Breakdown
• Supremacy of the Constitution — pinakamataas na batas, walang nakahihigit
• Three Branches — Executive (nagpapatupad), Legislative (gumagawa ng batas), Judicial (nagbibigay-kahulugan)
• Separation of Powers at Checks and Balances
• Bill of Rights (Article III)
• Citizenship (Article IV)

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang Constitution ay parang "rules ng bahay" ng buong bansa — lahat, kahit ang Pangulo, ay kailangang sumunod dito. Hinahati nito ang kapangyarihan sa tatlong sangay para walang sinuman ang magkaroon ng walang limitasyong kapangyarihan.

📦 Halimbawa
• Supremacy: Kahit ang Pangulo ay kailangang sumunod sa Konstitusyon.
• Legislative: Ang Kongreso ang gumagawa at nagpapasa ng mga batas.
• Executive: Ang Pangulo at mga ahensya ang nagpapatupad.
• Judicial: Ang mga hukuman ang nagbibigay-kahulugan sa batas.
• Bill of Rights: Karapatan ng isang tao na magpahayag ng opinyon, basta sumusunod sa batas.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Pundasyon ito ng lahat ng batas sa Pilipinas. Madalas itong lumabas sa CSE — constitutional articles, branches of government, at Bill of Rights.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Mga articles na madalas lumabas:
• Article II — Declaration of Principles and State Policies
• Article III — Bill of Rights
• Article IV — Citizenship
• Article VI — Legislative Department
• Article VII — Executive Department
• Article VIII — Judicial Department
• Article IX — Constitutional Commissions (CSC, COMELEC, COA)
• Article XI — Accountability of Public Officers
• Article XVII — Amendments or Revisions

🎯 Exam Tip
I-memorize ang article numbers at ang kanilang subject. Madalas ang tanong: "Anong article ang Bill of Rights?" (Article III) o "Anong article ang Citizenship?" (Article IV).

ai.prompt: Explain what the Philippine Constitution is and why it is supreme.

paragraphs.text: The 1987 Philippine Constitution is the supreme law of the Republic of the Philippines. It establishes the fundamental principles, structure, and powers of the government, defines the relationship between the government and its people, and protects the fundamental rights and freedoms of individuals. It also establishes the three branches of government: the Executive, Legislative, and Judicial branches, which operate under the principle of separation of powers and checks and balances.

ai.title: Ano ang Constitution?
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang 1987 Philippine Constitution ay pinakamataas na batas ng Pilipinas. Nakasaad dito ang prinsipyo ng gobyerno, kapangyarihan nito, at karapatan ng mamamayan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Tatlong branches: Executive (nagpapatupad ng batas), Legislative (gumagawa ng batas), at Judicial (nagbibigay-kahulugan). Gumagana sila sa principle ng separation of powers at checks and balances.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Walang sinuman — kahit ang Pangulo — ang nakahihigit sa Constitution.
ai.prompt: Explain this definition of the Philippine Constitution with its three branches.

ai.title: Mahahalagang Konsepto
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Limang pangunahing konsepto: supremacy, three branches, separation of powers, Bill of Rights, at citizenship.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang bawat isa ay may specific na role at pinoprotektahan ang balance ng power sa gobyerno.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang Bill of Rights (Article III) ang pinakamadaling lumabas sa exam — alamin ang mga specific rights.
ai.prompt: Explain the five key concepts of the Philippine Constitution with examples.

paragraphs.label: 1. Supremacy of the Constitution:
paragraphs.text: The Constitution is the highest law of the country. All other laws, government policies, and official actions must be consistent with its provisions.

ai.title: Supremacy of the Constitution
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Constitution ang pinakamataas na batas — lahat ng ibang batas, policies, at official actions ay dapat sumunod dito.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kapag may conflict sa pagitan ng Constitution at ordinary law, ang Constitution ang masusunod.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Walang batas na pwedeng lumabag sa Constitution — pag lumabag, unconstitutional ito.
ai.prompt: Explain supremacy of the Constitution with examples.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: A law that violates a constitutional right may be declared unconstitutional by the Supreme Court.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Supremacy
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano ipinapatupad ang supremacy?
Sagot: Ang Supreme Court ay may kapangyarihang i-declare na unconstitutional ang isang batas kung lumalabag ito sa Constitution.
ai.prompt: Explain how the Supreme Court enforces constitutional supremacy.

paragraphs.label: 2. Three Branches of Government:
paragraphs.text: The Philippine government is divided into three branches, each with distinct responsibilities.

ai.title: Tatlong Sangay ng Gobyerno
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang gobyerno ay nahahati sa tatlong branches: Executive, Legislative, Judicial.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Bawat branch ay may kanya-kanyang responsibilidad para hindi maipon ang kapangyarihan sa isang tao o grupo.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Executive = nagpapatupad; Legislative = gumagawa ng batas; Judicial = nagbibigay-kahulugan.
ai.prompt: Explain the three branches of the Philippine government.

paragraphs.label: Executive Branch:
paragraphs.text: Implements and enforces laws. Headed by the President of the Philippines.

ai.title: Executive Branch
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Executive Branch ay nagpapatupad at nag-eenforce ng mga batas. Pinamumunuan ng Pangulo.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kapag may bagong batas, ang Pangulo at mga ahensya (DOH, DepEd, DPWH, etc.) ang nagpapatupad nito.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang Pangulo ay may veto power sa mga bill na ipinasa ng Congress.
ai.prompt: Explain the Executive Branch and its responsibilities.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: The President directs government agencies in implementing national policies.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Executive
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano nagpapatupad ang Pangulo?
Sagot: Sa pamamagitan ng mga ahensya ng gobyerno — halimbawa, pag-utos sa DepEd na magpatupad ng bagong curriculum.
ai.prompt: Explain how the President implements policies through agencies.

paragraphs.label: Legislative Branch:
paragraphs.text: Creates, amends, and repeals laws. Composed of the Senate and the House of Representatives, collectively known as Congress.

ai.title: Legislative Branch
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Legislative Branch (Congress) ang gumagawa, nag-aamend, at nag-repeal ng mga batas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Binubuo ng Senate (24 senators) at House of Representatives (mga congressman). Sila ang gumagawa ng batas.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang isang bill ay kailangang pumasa sa parehong Senate at House bago pumunta sa Pangulo para pirmahan.
ai.prompt: Explain the Legislative Branch and its law-making role.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: Congress passes a proposed law concerning taxation.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Legislative
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano gumagawa ng batas ang Congress?
Sagot: Isang proposed law (bill) ang pinag-debatehan at binoboto sa Senate at House. Kapag pasado sa dalawa, pupunta sa Pangulo para sa approval.
ai.prompt: Explain how Congress passes a law.

paragraphs.label: Judicial Branch:
paragraphs.text: Interprets laws and settles legal disputes. Headed by the Supreme Court.

ai.title: Judicial Branch
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Judicial Branch ay nagbibigay-kahulugan sa batas at lumulutas ng legal disputes. Pinamumunuan ng Supreme Court.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Sila ang nagde-determine kung ano ang ibig sabihin ng isang batas sa isang specific na sitwasyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang Supreme Court ang may final say — kung unconstitutional, invalid ang batas.
ai.prompt: Explain the Judicial Branch and its role.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: The Supreme Court determines whether a government action violates the Constitution.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Judicial
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano nagbibigay-kahulugan ang Supreme Court?
Sagot: Kapag may question sa constitutionality ng isang batas o aksyon, ang Supreme Court ang nagde-decide kung valid ito o hindi.
ai.prompt: Explain how the Supreme Court reviews constitutionality.

paragraphs.label: 3. Separation of Powers and Checks and Balances:
paragraphs.text: These principles prevent any single branch of government from having unlimited authority.

ai.title: Separation of Powers at Checks and Balances
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang separation of powers ay naghahati ng kapangyarihan sa 3 branches. Ang checks and balances ay nagbibigay ng kapangyarihan sa bawat branch na i-check ang iba.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Walang branch ang pwedeng gumawa ng lahat — bawat isa ay may limitasyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hindi ito pareho: separation = hiwalay na roles; checks = bawat branch may power over ibang branches.
ai.prompt: Explain separation of powers and checks and balances.

paragraphs.label: Separation of Powers:
paragraphs.text: Each branch has its own constitutional responsibilities.

ai.title: Separation of Powers
ai.content:
Tanong: Ano ang separation of powers?
Sagot: Bawat branch ay may kanya-kanyang responsibilidad na hindi ginagawa ng ibang branch. Legislative = gumawa ng batas; Executive = magpatupad; Judicial = magbigay-kahulugan.
ai.prompt: Explain separation of powers in detail.

paragraphs.label: Checks and Balances:
paragraphs.text: Each branch has certain powers to limit or review the actions of the other branches.

ai.title: Checks and Balances
ai.content:
Tanong: Ano ang checks and balances?
Sagot: Bawat branch ay may power na i-review o limitahan ang iba. Halimbawa, ang Pangulo ay may veto, ang Congress ay may override, at ang Supreme Court ay may judicial review.
ai.prompt: Explain checks and balances with examples.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: The President may veto a bill passed by Congress, while Congress may override the veto under the constitutional requirements.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Checks and Balances
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano nag-i-check ang branches sa isa't isa?
Sagot: Pangulo → may veto sa bill ng Congress. Congress → may override ng veto (2/3 vote ng both houses). Supreme Court → may judicial review (ide-declare na unconstitutional).
ai.prompt: Explain the veto and override process as an example of checks and balances.

paragraphs.label: 4. Bill of Rights (Article III):
paragraphs.text: The Bill of Rights protects individuals against abuses of government power and guarantees fundamental freedoms.

ai.title: Bill of Rights (Article III)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Bill of Rights ay nagpoprotekta sa mga indibidwal laban sa abuse ng gobyerno. Nasa Article III ito ng Constitution.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Karapatan mo ito — hindi pwedeng bawiin ng gobyerno nang walang due process.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Article III = Bill of Rights. Madalas itong lumabas sa CSE.
ai.prompt: Explain the Bill of Rights and why it's in Article III.

paragraphs.text: Important rights include: freedom of speech and expression, freedom of religion, right to due process of law, equal protection of the laws, right against unreasonable searches and seizures, right to privacy of communication, right to a speedy and public trial.

ai.title: Mahahalagang Karapatan sa Bill of Rights
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pitong mahalagang karapatan sa Bill of Rights:

1. Freedom of speech and expression
2. Freedom of religion
3. Right to due process
4. Equal protection of the laws
5. Right against unreasonable searches and seizures
6. Right to privacy of communication
7. Right to speedy and public trial

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang lahat ng ito ay nagpoprotekta sa iyo laban sa abuse ng gobyerno.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang "due process" ay ang karapatang magkaroon ng tamang legal procedure bago ka parusahan o bawiin ng karapatan.
ai.prompt: Explain the key rights in the Bill of Rights with examples.

paragraphs.label: 5. Citizenship (Article IV):
paragraphs.text: The Constitution identifies who are considered citizens of the Philippines.

ai.title: Citizenship (Article IV)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Article IV ay nagsasaad kung sino ang itinuturing na citizen ng Pilipinas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ayon sa Article IV, Section 1, ang mga citizen ay: (1) ang mga citizen na noong i-adopt ang 1987 Constitution, (2) ang mga anak ng Pilipinong ama o ina, (3) ang mga ipinanganak bago ang January 17, 1973 ng Pilipinang ina na pumili ng Philippine citizenship pagtungtong ng legal age, at (4) ang mga naturalized ayon sa batas.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Article IV = Citizenship. Ang natural-born ay citizen mula pagsilang na walang kailangang gawin para makuha ang citizenship. Ang pagkawala at muling pagkuha ng citizenship ay ayon sa batas (Section 3).
ai.prompt: Explain Philippine citizenship under Article IV with examples.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: A person whose father or mother is a Filipino citizen is generally considered a natural-born Filipino citizen, subject to the constitutional provisions.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Citizenship
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano maging natural-born citizen?
Sagot: Kung ang ama o ina ay Filipino citizen, natural-born citizen ang anak. Hindi kailangang mag-naturalize.
ai.prompt: Explain natural-born citizenship through Filipino parents.

ai.title: Article VI: Legislative Department
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Kongreso ay binubuo ng Senado at ng Kapulungan ng mga Kinatawan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Alamin ang termino, qualifications, at mga espesyal na tuntunin sa paggawa ng batas.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Madalas itanong ang edad, termino, at botong kailangan.
ai.prompt: Explain Article VI: Legislative Department in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Congress:
paragraphs.text: Congress consists of the Senate (24 Senators elected at large) and the House of Representatives. Senators serve six years with no more than two consecutive terms. Members of the House serve three years with no more than three consecutive terms.

ai.title: Congress
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Senado at Kamara ang bumubuo sa Kongreso.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Senador: 6 na taon, hanggang 2 magkasunod. Kinatawan: 3 taon, hanggang 3 magkasunod.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang Senado ay may 24 na miyembro.
ai.prompt: Explain Congress in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Qualifications of Legislators:
paragraphs.text: Senator: natural-born citizen, at least 35 years old on election day, able to read and write, registered voter, and a resident of the Philippines for at least 2 years. Representative: natural-born citizen, at least 25 years old, able to read and write, registered voter in the district, and a resident there for at least 1 year.

ai.title: Qualifications of Legislators
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga kwalipikasyon ng Senador at Kinatawan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Senador: 35 taong gulang. Kinatawan: 25 taong gulang.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang Pangulo at Pangalawang Pangulo ay 40.
ai.prompt: Explain Qualifications of Legislators in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Special Rules on Bills:
paragraphs.text: Appropriation, revenue or tariff bills, bills increasing public debt, bills of local application, and private bills originate exclusively in the House. The Senate may propose or concur with amendments. To override a presidential veto, two-thirds of all the Members of each House must vote to pass the bill again.

ai.title: Special Rules on Bills
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga tuntunin sa pinagmulan ng bill at sa veto override.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Appropriation, revenue, at tariff bills ay sa Kamara nagsisimula.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Dalawang-katlo ng LAHAT ng Miyembro ng bawat Kapulungan, hindi lang ng mga dumalo.
ai.prompt: Explain Special Rules on Bills in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

ai.title: Article VII: Executive Department
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Pangulo ang pinuno ng Executive Branch.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Alamin ang termino, kwalipikasyon, at pagpalit sa Pangulo.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Isang termino lang ang Pangulo; ang Pangalawang Pangulo ay hanggang dalawa.
ai.prompt: Explain Article VII: Executive Department in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: President and Vice-President:
paragraphs.text: They are elected by direct vote of the people for six years. The President cannot be reelected. The Vice-President may serve no more than two successive terms.

ai.title: President and Vice-President
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Termino at reelection ng dalawang pinuno.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Pangulo: 6 na taon, walang reelection. Bise Presidente: hanggang dalawang magkasunod na termino.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Huwag pagpalitin ang dalawa.
ai.prompt: Explain President and Vice-President in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Qualifications of the President:
paragraphs.text: A natural-born citizen, a registered voter, able to read and write, at least 40 years old on election day, and a resident of the Philippines for at least 10 years before the election.

ai.title: Qualifications of the President
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga kwalipikasyon ng Pangulo.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Pinakamababang edad ay 40; 10 taong residency.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Mas mataas ang edad kaysa sa Senador (35).
ai.prompt: Explain Qualifications of the President in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Succession:
paragraphs.text: The Vice-President succeeds if the President dies or is permanently unable to serve. If both offices are vacant, the Senate President (or, if he cannot act, the Speaker) acts as President until a new President or Vice-President is elected and qualified.

ai.title: Succession
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Susunod na hahalili sa Pangulo.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Una ang Pangalawang Pangulo, sunod ang Senate President, saka ang Speaker.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang Chief Justice ay hindi kasama sa linya.
ai.prompt: Explain Succession in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Martial Law and Habeas Corpus:
paragraphs.text: In case of invasion or rebellion when public safety requires it, the President may suspend the privilege of the writ of habeas corpus or place the country under martial law for not more than 60 days. The President must report to Congress within 48 hours, and Congress may revoke the proclamation by a majority vote of all its Members.

ai.title: Martial Law and Habeas Corpus
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga kapangyarihan ng Pangulo bilang Commander-in-Chief sa panahon ng krisis.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hanggang 60 araw lang at kailangang mag-ulat sa Kongreso sa loob ng 48 oras.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang batayan ay invasion o rebellion lang.
ai.prompt: Explain Martial Law and Habeas Corpus in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

sections.heading: Judiciary (Article VIII) and Constitutional Commissions (Article IX)

ai.title: Article VIII at IX
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Hudikatura at ang tatlong Constitutional Commissions.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Alamin ang bilang ng mahistrado, edad ng pagreretiro, at termino ng mga komisyoner.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang Constitutional Commissions ay independent.
ai.prompt: Explain Article VIII at IX in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Supreme Court:
paragraphs.text: The Supreme Court has a Chief Justice and 14 Associate Justices (15 in all). Members of the Supreme Court and judges of lower courts hold office until they reach age 70 or become incapacitated.

ai.title: Supreme Court
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Komposisyon at pagreretiro ng mga mahistrado.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
15 lahat: 1 Chief Justice at 14 Associate Justices. Retirement: 70.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hindi 65 ang retirement age ng mga mahistrado.
ai.prompt: Explain Supreme Court in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Judicial and Bar Council (JBC):
paragraphs.text: The JBC recommends appointees to the Judiciary (and to the Office of the Ombudsman). The President appoints from the JBC's list.

ai.title: Judicial and Bar Council (JBC)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang JBC ang nagmumungkahi ng mga nominado.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi ang Pangulo ang direktang pumipili; pumipili siya mula sa listahan ng JBC.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hindi ito ang Commission on Appointments.
ai.prompt: Explain Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Constitutional Commissions:
paragraphs.text: The three independent Constitutional Commissions are the Civil Service Commission (CSC), the Commission on Elections (COMELEC), and the Commission on Audit (COA). The Chairman and Commissioners serve seven years without reappointment.

ai.title: Constitutional Commissions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Tatlong independent na komisyon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
CSC, COMELEC, COA; pitong taon at walang reappointment.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang CHR ay hindi Constitutional Commission sa ilalim ng Art IX.
ai.prompt: Explain Constitutional Commissions in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

ai.title: Article XI at XVII
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Impeachment, public trust, at paraan ng pag-amyenda ng Saligang Batas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Alamin kung sino ang puwedeng i-impeach at ang mga boto na kailangan.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang Senado ang naglilitis ng impeachment.
ai.prompt: Explain Article XI at XVII in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Impeachable Officers:
paragraphs.text: The President, the Vice-President, Members of the Supreme Court, Members of the Constitutional Commissions, and the Ombudsman. Cabinet secretaries are not impeachable.

ai.title: Impeachable Officers
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga opisyal na puwedeng i-impeach.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi kasama ang mga Cabinet secretary.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Limang uri lang ang nakalista.
ai.prompt: Explain Impeachable Officers in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Grounds and Procedure:
paragraphs.text: The grounds are culpable violation of the Constitution, treason, bribery, graft and corruption, other high crimes, and betrayal of public trust. The House has the exclusive power to initiate impeachment: a verified complaint filed by at least one-third of all its Members becomes the Articles of Impeachment. The Senate has the sole power to try and decide. Conviction requires two-thirds of all the Members of the Senate. The penalty is removal and disqualification, but the person may still be prosecuted in court.

ai.title: Grounds and Procedure
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Proseso ng impeachment.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kamara ang nagsisimula (1/3 ng mga Miyembro para sa Articles of Impeachment); Senado ang naglilitis; 2/3 ng lahat ng Senador ang kailangan para ma-convict.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Removal at disqualification lang ang parusa sa impeachment mismo.
ai.prompt: Explain Grounds and Procedure in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Public Trust and the Ombudsman:
paragraphs.text: Article XI, Section 1 states that public office is a public trust. The Ombudsman and Deputies, as 'protectors of the people,' act promptly on complaints against public officials and employees.

ai.title: Public Trust and the Ombudsman
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pananagutan ng mga opisyal ng gobyerno.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang Ombudsman ang 'protector of the people'.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang 'public office is a public trust' ay nasa Article XI.
ai.prompt: Explain Public Trust and the Ombudsman in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Amending the Constitution:
paragraphs.text: Proposals may come from Congress (three-fourths vote of all its Members), a Constitutional Convention (called by a two-thirds vote of all Members of Congress, or by a majority vote of all its Members submitting the question of calling one to the electorate), or, for amendments only, a people's initiative signed by at least 12% of registered voters, with at least 3% in every legislative district. Amendments are ratified by a majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite held 60 to 90 days after approval.

ai.title: Amending the Constitution
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga paraan ng pag-amyenda at pagratipika.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kailangan ang plebisito: mayorya ng boto na ibinoto.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
12% at 3% ang bilang para sa people's initiative.
ai.prompt: Explain Amending the Constitution in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

sections.heading: More Rights in the Bill of Rights (Article III)

ai.title: Dagdag na Karapatan sa Article III
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga karapatan tungkol sa paghahanap, pag-aresto, at paglilitis.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang mga ito ay madalas lumabas bilang scenario-based na tanong.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Alamin ang eksaktong kondisyon ng bawat karapatan.
ai.prompt: Explain Dagdag na Karapatan sa Article III in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Search Warrants (Section 2):
paragraphs.text: A search warrant may be issued only upon probable cause determined personally by a judge after examining the complainant and witnesses under oath.

ai.title: Search Warrants (Section 2)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga kondisyon para sa search warrant.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang hukom mismo ang magtutukoy ng probable cause.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hindi ito maaaring ibigay ng prosecutor o pulis.
ai.prompt: Explain Search Warrants (Section 2) in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Custodial Investigation (Section 12):
paragraphs.text: A person under investigation must be informed of the right to remain silent and to have competent and independent counsel, preferably of his own choice. If he cannot afford one, counsel must be provided.

ai.title: Custodial Investigation (Section 12)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang 'Miranda rights' sa Pilipinas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
May karapatang manahimik at magkaroon ng abogado, libre kung walang kakayahan.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hindi kailangang hintayin na may kaso na sa korte.
ai.prompt: Explain Custodial Investigation (Section 12) in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Habeas Corpus (Section 15):
paragraphs.text: The privilege of the writ of habeas corpus may not be suspended except in cases of invasion or rebellion, when public safety requires it.

ai.title: Habeas Corpus (Section 15)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang writ na nag-uutos na iharap ang taong nakakulong.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Tanging invasion o rebellion ang batayan ng suspensyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang 'lawless violence' ay hindi batayan ng suspensyon.
ai.prompt: Explain Habeas Corpus (Section 15) in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Rights of the Accused:
paragraphs.text: The accused is presumed innocent until proven guilty (Section 14). No person may be put twice in jeopardy for the same offense (Section 21). No person may be imprisoned for debt (Section 20).

ai.title: Rights of the Accused
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga proteksyon ng akusado.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Inosente hanggang mapatunayang nagkasala; walang double jeopardy; walang kulong sa utang.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang bigat ng patunay ay nasa prosekusyon.
ai.prompt: Explain Rights of the Accused in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

ai.title: Gabay sa RA 6713
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 6713 (Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees) ay batas na nagtatakda ng tamang asal, etika, at responsibilidad ng mga opisyal at empleyado ng pamahalaan.

🔍 Breakdown
• 8 Norms of Conduct (Section 4)
• Prohibited Acts and Transactions (Section 7)
• SALN (Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth)

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag

ai.title: Gabay sa Peace and Human Rights
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang peace and human rights ay tumutukoy sa pagpapanatili ng kapayapaan at pagprotekta sa mga pangunahing karapatan at dignidad ng bawat tao.

🔍 Breakdown
• UDHR — Universal Declaration of Human Rights
• Civil at Political Rights
• Economic, Social, Cultural Rights
• Equality at Non-Discrimination
• Peacebuilding
• Human Dignity

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Lahat ng tao ay nararapat tratuhin nang patas at may respeto, anuman ang kasarian, relihiyon, lahi, paniniwala, o estado sa buhay. Hindi lang ito tungkol sa kawalan ng gulo — kasama rin ang katarungan, pagkakapantay-pantay, kalayaan, at paggalang.

📦 Halimbawa
• Right to Life: Karapatang mabuhay at maprotektahan laban sa ilegal na pagkitil.
• Freedom of Expression: Malayang pagpapahayag ng opinyon.
• Equality: Pantay na pagtrato sa lahat.
• Peacebuilding: Pag-usapan ang hindi pagkakaunawaan, hindi karahasan.
• Human Dignity: Walang dapat maliitin o ipahiya.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Core values ito ng isang demokratikong lipunan. Madalas itong lumabas sa CSE — lalo na ang UDHR at human rights principles.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
• UDHR — Adopted on December 10, 1948 ng UN General Assembly
• Human Rights — Basic rights ng bawat tao
• Peacebuilding — Preventing at resolving conflicts through peaceful means
• Equality — Equal dignity without unfair discrimination

🎯 Exam Tip
Memorize ang petsa ng UDHR (December 10, 1948) at ang UN General Assembly bilang nag-adopt nito — madalas itong tanong. Tandaan din: ang UDHR ay may 30 articles; ang CHR ay may Chairman at 4 na Miyembro at walang judicial power; at ang mga pangunahing batas ay RA 9262 (VAWC), RA 7610 (proteksyon ng bata), RA 9745 (anti-torture), at RA 11313 (Safe Spaces).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan

ai.prompt: Explain what peace and human rights mean.

paragraphs.text: Peace and human rights refer to the promotion of peaceful relationships, justice, equality, respect, and protection of the inherent dignity and fundamental rights of every human being. Human rights are basic rights and freedoms that belong to all individuals regardless of nationality, race, sex, religion, language, social status, or other personal circumstances. Peace involves preventing violence, resolving conflicts through peaceful means, respecting differences, and promoting cooperation within communities and nations.

ai.title: Ano ang Peace and Human Rights?
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang peace ay pag-iwas sa violence at peaceful resolution ng conflict. Ang human rights ay basic rights ng lahat ng tao, anuman ang lahi, kasarian, relihiyon, o estado.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag

ai.title: Mahahalagang Konsepto
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Anim na mahalagang konsepto sa peace and human rights: UDHR, civil/political rights, economic/social/cultural rights, equality, peacebuilding, human dignity.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Bawat isa ay nagpoprotekta sa iba't ibang aspeto ng buhay ng tao — mula sa basic rights hanggang sa dignity.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang UDHR (1948) ang pinaka-fundamental na international document sa human rights.
ai.prompt: Explain the six key concepts in peace and human rights.

paragraphs.label: 1. Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR):
paragraphs.text: The UDHR is an international declaration adopted by the United Nations General Assembly on December 10, 1948. It establishes a common standard of fundamental human rights and freedoms for all people.

ai.title: UDHR
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang UDHR ay international declaration na in-adopt ng UN General Assembly noong December 10, 1948. Ito ang common standard ng human rights para sa lahat ng tao.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang pinaka-fundamental na dokumento ng human rights sa buong mundo — sinusunod ng maraming bansa.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
December 10, 1948 — madalas lumabas sa exam.
ai.prompt: Explain the UDHR and its significance.

paragraphs.text: Important rights recognized include: right to life, liberty, and security; right to equality before the law; freedom of thought, religion, and expression; right to education; right to work; right to participate in government; right against torture and slavery.

ai.title: Mga Karapatan sa UDHR
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pitong mahalagang karapatan sa UDHR:

1. Right to life, liberty, and security
2. Equality before the law
3. Freedom of thought, religion, expression
4. Right to education
5. Right to work
6. Right to participate in government
7. Right against torture and slavery

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Lahat ng ito ay basic rights — walang dapat mabawasan kahit kanino.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Right against torture at slavery — pinaka-basic na karapatan ng tao.
ai.prompt: Explain the rights enumerated in the UDHR.

paragraphs.label: 2. Civil and Political Rights:
paragraphs.text: These protect an individual's freedom and participation in society and government. Example: The right to vote, freedom of speech, and freedom of religion.

ai.title: Civil at Political Rights
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang civil at political rights ay nagpoprotekta sa freedom at participation sa society at government.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Right to vote, freedom of speech, freedom of religion — mga karapatang pampulitika at personal.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Civil = personal freedoms; Political = participation sa government.
ai.prompt: Explain civil and political rights with examples.

paragraphs.label: 3. Economic, Social, and Cultural Rights:
paragraphs.text: These protect the conditions necessary for people to live with dignity and participate in society. Example: The right to education, healthcare, decent working conditions, and participation in cultural activities.

ai.title: Economic, Social, Cultural Rights
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang mga ito ay nagpoprotekta sa kondisyon para mabuhay nang may dignidad: education, healthcare, decent work, cultural participation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Basic needs ito — hindi lang freedom, kundi quality of life.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Education at healthcare — madalas lumabas sa exam.
ai.prompt: Explain economic, social, and cultural rights with examples.

paragraphs.label: 4. Equality and Non-Discrimination:
paragraphs.text: All individuals should receive equal protection and respect regardless of their personal backgrounds or circumstances. Example: A school or workplace should not unfairly discriminate against someone because of their religion or gender.

ai.title: Equality and Non-Discrimination
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pantay na proteksyon at respeto sa lahat — walang diskriminasyon base sa religion, gender, race, etc.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Walang special treatment, walang unfair treatment — pantay lang.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Anti-discrimination — core principle ito ng human rights.
ai.prompt: Explain equality and non-discrimination with examples.

paragraphs.label: 5. Peacebuilding and Conflict Resolution:
paragraphs.text: Peacebuilding involves preventing conflicts and developing peaceful solutions through communication, cooperation, negotiation, and mediation. Example: Two communities experiencing a disagreement should seek dialogue and peaceful settlement rather than violence.

ai.title: Peacebuilding
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang peacebuilding ay pag-iwas sa conflict at paghahanap ng peaceful solutions through dialogue, cooperation, negotiation, at mediation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kung may hindi pagkakaunawaan, pag-usapan — hindi karahasan.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Peace ≠ absence of war — active resolution ito ng conflicts.
ai.prompt: Explain peacebuilding and conflict resolution with examples.

paragraphs.label: 6. Human Dignity:
paragraphs.text: Every person deserves respect and fair treatment simply because they are human. Example: No individual should be subjected to humiliation, torture, or degrading treatment.

ai.title: Human Dignity
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Bawat tao ay karapat-dapat sa respeto at fair treatment dahil tao siya.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Walang dapat ipahiya, saktan, o abusuhin — kahit sino pa siya.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Walang torture, walang degrading treatment — basic ito.
ai.prompt: Explain human dignity with examples.

ai.title: UDHR, Henerasyon ng Karapatan, at CHR

Mga pangunahing facts tungkol sa UDHR, uri ng karapatan, at CHR.

paragraphs.label: UDHR Facts:
paragraphs.text: The UDHR has a preamble and 30 articles. Article 1 states: 'All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights.' Eleanor Roosevelt chaired the UN Commission on Human Rights while it was being drafted.

ai.title: UDHR Facts
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mahahalagang detalye ng UDHR.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
30 articles; adopted noong Dec 10, 1948; si Eleanor Roosevelt ang tagapangulo ng komisyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang Article 1 ay tungkol sa pagkakapantay-pantay.
ai.prompt: Explain UDHR Facts in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Generations of Rights:
paragraphs.text: First generation: civil and political rights (for example, voting and a fair trial). Second generation: economic, social, and cultural rights (for example, education and health care). Third generation: solidarity rights (for example, development, peace, and a healthy environment). Some rights, such as freedom from torture, are absolute and cannot be limited even in an emergency.

ai.title: Generations of Rights
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Tatlong henerasyon ng karapatan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Una: civil-political. Ikalawa: socio-economic. Ikatlo: solidarity.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang freedom from torture ay absolute.
ai.prompt: Explain Generations of Rights in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Commission on Human Rights (CHR):
paragraphs.text: Created by Article XIII, Section 17 of the Constitution, the CHR is composed of a Chairman and four Members. It investigates human rights violations and provides legal aid, but it has no judicial power to try and decide cases.

ai.title: Commission on Human Rights (CHR)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang tagapagbantay ng karapatang pantao sa Pilipinas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Nag-iimbestiga at nagrerekomenda, pero hindi nagpapasya ng kaso.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Chairman at apat na Miyembro.
ai.prompt: Explain Commission on Human Rights (CHR) in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

Batas para sa kapayapaan sa Mindanao.

RA 11054.

Itugma ang writ sa karapatang pinoprotektahan nito.

paragraphs.label: Writs:
paragraphs.text: The writ of amparo protects the right to life, liberty, and security against extralegal killings and enforced disappearances. The writ of habeas data protects privacy in information gathered about a person. The writ of habeas corpus secures release from illegal detention. The writ of kalikasan protects the right to a balanced and healthful ecology.

ai.title: Writs
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga legal na remedyo para sa karapatan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Amparo = buhay at seguridad; habeas data = privacy; habeas corpus = pagpapalaya; kalikasan = kalikasan.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Huwag pagpalitin ang amparo at habeas corpus.
ai.prompt: Explain Writs in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: International Humanitarian Law:
paragraphs.text: The four Geneva Conventions of 1949 protect persons who do not take part in fighting or can no longer fight. The principle of distinction requires parties to distinguish combatants from civilians, and military objectives from civilian objects. The International Criminal Court handles genocide, crimes against humanity, war crimes, and the crime of aggression.

ai.title: International Humanitarian Law
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga alituntunin sa panahon ng armadong labanan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Apat ang Geneva Conventions; ang distinction ay paghihiwalay ng sibilyan at kombatant.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hindi sakop ng ICC ang piracy.
ai.prompt: Explain International Humanitarian Law in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Peace Concepts:
paragraphs.text: Positive peace means the presence of justice and equality, not just the absence of war. In mediation, a neutral third party helps the disputing parties reach their own agreement without imposing a decision. In the barangay, the Lupong Tagapamayapa mediates and conciliates disputes under the Katarungang Pambarangay system.

ai.title: Peace Concepts
ai.content:

Mga konsepto ng kapayapaan at pag-aayos ng alitan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang mediator ay tumutulong, hindi nagpapataw ng desisyon.

Ang Lupong Tagapamayapa ay pinamumunuan ng Punong Barangay.

ai.title: Gabay sa Environmental Management
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang environmental management ay responsible planning, protection, conservation, at sustainable use ng natural resources.

🔍 Breakdown
Anim na mahalagang batas:
• RA 9003 — Ecological Solid Waste Management
• RA 8749 — Clean Air Act
• RA 9275 — Clean Water Act
• RA 6969 — Toxic Substances at Hazardous Wastes
• RA 9729 — Climate Change Act
• RA 9512 — Environmental Awareness and Education

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Layunin nitong maiwasan ang polusyon, pagkasira ng kalikasan, at pagkaubos ng resources — para mapakinabangan pa ito ng susunod na henerasyon.

📦 Halimbawa
• RA 9003: Paghihiwalay ng biodegradable, recyclable, residual, special waste.
• RA 8749: Kontrol sa usok ng sasakyan at pabrika.
• RA 9275: Huwag magtapon ng wastewater sa ilog.
• RA 9729: Programa para sa climate adaptation at mitigation (ang disaster preparedness ay RA 10121).
• Reforestation: Pagtatanim ng puno sa kalbong lugar.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Napakalaking bahagi ito ng CSE General Information — lalo na ang identification ng RA numbers.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Memorize ang table:
• RA 9003 → Ecological Solid Waste Management
• RA 8749 → Clean Air Act
• RA 9275 → Clean Water Act
• RA 6969 → Toxic Substances and Hazardous Wastes
• RA 9729 → Climate Change Act
• RA 9512 → Environmental Awareness and Education Act

🎯 Exam Tip
Madalas mag-match ang tanong ng RA number at description. Memory aid: isaulo ayon sa order ng paksa — Waste, Air, Water, Toxic, Climate, Education → 9003, 8749, 9275, 6969, 9729, 9512. Tandaan din na mas mataas ang RA number, mas bago ang batas (6969 noong 1990 → 9729 noong 2009). Focus sa pinaka-common: 9003 (waste), 8749 (air), 9275 (water). Dagdag na pointers: RA 9147 (wildlife), RA 10121 (disaster risk reduction at management), at PD 1586 (ECC para sa mga proyekto).
ai.prompt: Explain environmental management in simple Tagalog — RA 9003, 8749, 9275, 6969, 9729, 9512 — with mnemonic and CSE exam tips.

ai.title: Kahulugan ng Environmental Management
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Responsible planning, protection, conservation, at sustainable use ng natural resources.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Pangangalaga sa hangin, tubig, lupa, kagubatan, at hayop — para sa susunod na henerasyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Sustainability ang core principle — gamitin pero huwag ubusin.
ai.prompt: Explain what environmental management is.

paragraphs.text: Environmental management refers to the responsible planning, protection, conservation, and sustainable use of natural resources to maintain ecological balance, prevent pollution, and protect the environment for present and future generations. It involves implementing environmental policies, managing waste, conserving biodiversity, reducing pollution, and promoting sustainable practices.

ai.title: Ano ang Environmental Management?
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Responsible planning, protection, conservation, at sustainable use ng natural resources.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kasama rito ang pagsunod sa batas, tamang waste disposal, conservation, at pangangalaga sa halaman at hayop.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Para sa present at future generations — hindi lang para sa ngayon.
ai.prompt: Explain this definition of environmental management.

ai.title: Philippine Environmental Laws
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Anim na pangunahing environmental laws sa Pilipinas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Bawat batas ay may specific na focus: waste, air, water, toxic, climate, education.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang RA numbers ay madalas i-match sa description — memorized dapat.
ai.prompt: Explain the six main Philippine environmental laws.

paragraphs.label: 1. RA 9003 – Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000:
paragraphs.text: This law establishes a systematic program for managing solid waste through waste reduction, segregation, recycling, composting, and proper disposal. Example: Households should separate biodegradable, recyclable, residual, and special waste to support proper waste management.

ai.title: RA 9003 (Solid Waste)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 9003 ay batas tungkol sa waste reduction, segregation, recycling, composting, at proper disposal.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Paghihiwalay ng biodegradable, recyclable, residual, at special waste — ito ang core.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
RA 9003 = Solid Waste Management.
ai.prompt: Explain RA 9003 Ecological Solid Waste Management Act.

paragraphs.label: 2. RA 8749 – Philippine Clean Air Act of 1999:
paragraphs.text: This law aims to protect and maintain clean air by preventing and controlling air pollution. Example: Factories and vehicles must comply with applicable emission standards to reduce harmful air pollutants.

ai.title: RA 8749 (Clean Air)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 8749 ay batas para sa clean air — prevention at control ng air pollution.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Factories at vehicles dapat sumunod sa emission standards.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
RA 8749 = Clean Air Act.
ai.prompt: Explain RA 8749 Clean Air Act.

paragraphs.label: 3. RA 9275 – Philippine Clean Water Act of 2004:
paragraphs.text: This law aims to protect the country's water resources by preventing and controlling water pollution. Example: Factories must properly manage wastewater instead of releasing untreated industrial waste into rivers.

ai.title: RA 9275 (Clean Water)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 9275 ay batas para sa water resources — prevention at control ng water pollution.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Factories dapat i-manage ang wastewater — hindi ito itinatapon sa ilog.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
RA 9275 = Clean Water Act.
ai.prompt: Explain RA 9275 Clean Water Act.

paragraphs.label: 4. RA 6969 – Toxic Substances and Hazardous and Nuclear Wastes Control Act of 1990:
paragraphs.text: This law regulates the importation, manufacture, processing, distribution, use, and disposal of chemical substances and hazardous and nuclear wastes. Example: Hazardous chemical waste must be handled and disposed of according to applicable safety and environmental regulations.

ai.title: RA 6969 (Toxic Substances)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 6969 ay nagre-regulate ng chemical substances at hazardous/nuclear wastes.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Toxic at nuclear wastes ay may special handling rules — hindi pwedeng basta itapon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
RA 6969 = Toxic Substances and Hazardous Wastes.
ai.prompt: Explain RA 6969 Toxic Substances Control Act.

paragraphs.label: 5. RA 9729 – Climate Change Act of 2009:
paragraphs.text: This law integrates climate change considerations into government policies and establishes the Climate Change Commission. Example: Government agencies develop programs to prepare communities for climate-related risks such as floods, droughts, and stronger typhoons.

ai.title: RA 9729 (Climate Change)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 9729 ay nag-iintegrate ng climate change sa government policies at nagtatag ng Climate Change Commission.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Paghahanda sa floods, droughts, stronger typhoons — climate adaptation.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
RA 9729 = Climate Change Act. Nagtatag ito ng Climate Change Commission.
ai.prompt: Explain RA 9729 Climate Change Act.

paragraphs.label: 6. RA 9512 – National Environmental Awareness and Education Act of 2008:
paragraphs.text: This law promotes environmental awareness through environmental education in schools and other learning institutions. Example: Schools conduct environmental activities and lessons about pollution prevention, conservation, and waste management.

ai.title: RA 9512 (Environmental Education)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 9512 ay nagpo-promote ng environmental awareness through education sa schools.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Environmental education sa curriculum — para maging aware ang mga estudyante.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
RA 9512 = Environmental Awareness and Education Act.
ai.prompt: Explain RA 9512 Environmental Awareness and Education Act.

ai.title: Mga Environmental Practices
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pitong karaniwang environmental practices na dapat gawin ng bawat isa.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Simpleng aksyon ito sa araw-araw — waste segregation, recycling, composting, at iba pa.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Lahat ay nagsisimula sa maliit na gawi — daily habits ang susi.
ai.prompt: Explain the seven important environmental practices.

paragraphs.text: Important environmental management practices include: Waste Segregation (separating waste according to type), Recycling (processing used materials into new products), Composting (turning biodegradable waste into organic fertilizer), Reforestation (planting trees to restore forests), Water Conservation (avoiding unnecessary water consumption), Energy Conservation (reducing unnecessary electricity use), and Biodiversity Conservation (protecting different species of plants, animals, and their natural habitats).

ai.title: Pitong Environmental Practices
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pitong practices:

1. Waste Segregation — paghihiwalay ng basura by type
2. Recycling — processing used materials into new products
3. Composting — biodegradable waste → organic fertilizer
4. Reforestation — tree planting para restore forests
5. Water Conservation — tipirin ang tubig
6. Energy Conservation — tipirin ang kuryente
7. Biodiversity Conservation — protektahan ang species at habitats

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Lahat ito ay kaya mong gawin sa araw-araw — maliit man, malaking tulong.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Segregation at recycling — pinaka-basic at madalas lumabas sa exam.
ai.prompt: Explain the seven environmental practices with examples.

ai.title: Mahahalagang Probisyon ng RA 9003
ai.content:

Mga pangunahing probisyon ng Ecological Solid Waste Management Act.

Alamin ang papel ng barangay, ang mga bawal, at ang uri ng basura.

Ang barangay ang bahala sa segregation at collection ng biodegradable, compostable, at reusable.
ai.prompt: Explain Mahahalagang Probisyon ng RA 9003 in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.text: Barangays are responsible for segregation and collection of biodegradable, compostable, and reusable wastes. Every barangay or cluster of barangays must establish a Materials Recovery Facility (MRF). Collection of non-recyclable and special wastes is the responsibility of the city or municipality.

ai.title: Barangay Role
ai.content:

Tungkulin ng barangay sa solid waste.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
May MRF ang bawat barangay o grupo ng barangay.

Ang LGU ng lungsod o munisipyo ang sa non-recyclable at special.
ai.prompt: Explain Barangay Role in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

paragraphs.label: Prohibited Acts:
paragraphs.text: Open dumping, open burning of solid waste, littering, and mixing source-separated recyclables with other waste are prohibited.

ai.title: Prohibited Acts
ai.content:

Mga ipinagbabawal na gawain.

Bawal ang open dump at pagsunog ng basura.

Ang pagsunog ng basura ay bawal din sa Clean Air Act.

paragraphs.text: Compostable (food scraps), recyclable (paper, glass, metals, some plastics), residual (non-recyclable and non-compostable, such as used diapers), and special waste (household hazardous items such as batteries and paint).

ai.title: Types of Waste
ai.content:

Apat na uri ng basura.

Residual = hindi nabubulok at hindi nare-recycle. Special = delikadong gamit sa bahay.

paragraphs.text: The most preferred option is to reduce (prevent) waste, followed by reuse, recycle, recover, and finally dispose.

ai.title: Waste Hierarchy
ai.content:

Pagkakasunod-sunod ng pinakamainam na hakbang sa basura.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Bawasan muna bago i-recycle o itapon.

Ang disposal ay huling opsyon.
ai.prompt: Explain Waste Hierarchy in simple Taglish with a Civil Service Exam example.

Mga batas na madalas lumabas bukod sa anim na pangunahing batas.

Itugma ang batas sa layunin nito.

Ang RA 10121 ang batas para sa disaster risk reduction, hindi ang RA 9729.

paragraphs.label: Wildlife and Protected Areas:
paragraphs.text: RA 9147 (Wildlife Resources Conservation and Protection Act) protects wildlife and penalizes illegal wildlife trade. RA 11038 (E-NIPAS Act of 2018) expanded the National Integrated Protected Areas System.

ai.title: Wildlife and Protected Areas
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga batas para sa wildlife at protected areas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
9147 = wildlife; 11038 = pinalawak na protected areas.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang RA 7586 ay ang orihinal na NIPAS Act.

paragraphs.label: Environmental Impact Assessment:
paragraphs.text: PD 1586 established the Philippine Environmental Impact Statement System, which requires an Environmental Compliance Certificate (ECC) for projects that may significantly affect the environment. The DENR is the primary agency for environment and natural resources.

ai.title: Environmental Impact Assessment
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pagsusuri ng epekto ng proyekto sa kalikasan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kailangan ng ECC bago magsimula ang malaking proyekto.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
PD 1586.

paragraphs.label: Disaster Risk Reduction and Management:
paragraphs.text: RA 10121 (2010) has four thematic areas: prevention and mitigation, preparedness, response, and rehabilitation and recovery. The NDRRMC is chaired by the Secretary of National Defense. PHIVOLCS monitors volcanoes, earthquakes, and tsunamis, while PAGASA monitors weather and tropical cyclones.

ai.title: Disaster Risk Reduction and Management
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pamamahala sa mga sakuna.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Apat na thematic areas; DND Secretary ang chair ng NDRRMC.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
PHIVOLCS = lindol at bulkan; PAGASA = panahon.

paragraphs.label: Energy, Plastics, and Climate Change:
paragraphs.text: RA 9513 (Renewable Energy Act of 2008) promotes solar, wind, hydro, and biomass energy. RA 11898 (Extended Producer Responsibility Act of 2022) requires large companies to recover or offset their plastic packaging waste. Under RA 9729, the Climate Change Commission is chaired by the President.

ai.title: Energy, Plastics, and Climate Change
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga batas sa renewable energy, plastic, at climate change.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
9513 = renewable energy; 11898 = EPR; 9729 = Climate Change Commission na pinamumunuan ng Pangulo.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang RA 9136 ay EPIRA, hindi Renewable Energy Act.

ai.content:

Mga pangunahing konsepto at prinsipyong madalas itanong.

Magkaiba ang mitigation at adaptation.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang El Niño ay tagtuyot; ang La Niña ay maraming ulan.

paragraphs.label: Mitigation and Adaptation:
paragraphs.text: Mitigation reduces greenhouse gas emissions (for example, shifting from coal to solar and wind power). Adaptation prepares for the effects of climate change (for example, sea walls, flood-resistant crops, and relocation).

ai.title: Mitigation and Adaptation
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Dalawang paraan ng pagharap sa climate change.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Mitigation = bawasan ang sanhi. Adaptation = maghanda sa epekto.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang sea wall ay adaptation, hindi mitigation.

paragraphs.label: Greenhouse Gases and El Niño:
paragraphs.text: Carbon dioxide from burning fossil fuels is the main greenhouse gas. Landfills release methane when organic waste decomposes without oxygen. El Niño usually brings below-normal rainfall and drought to the Philippines, while La Niña brings more rain and floods.

ai.title: Greenhouse Gases and El Niño
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga gas at weather pattern.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
CO₂ ang pangunahing greenhouse gas; methane mula sa landfill.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
El Niño = tagtuyot.

paragraphs.label: Biodiversity and Mangroves:
paragraphs.text: Biodiversity is the variety of life, including genes, species, and ecosystems. Mangroves protect coasts from storm surges and erosion, serve as nurseries for fish and crustaceans, and store carbon.

ai.title: Biodiversity and Mangroves
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pagkakaiba-iba ng buhay at ang halaga ng mangroves.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang mangroves ay proteksyon sa baybayin at tirahan ng mga isda.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hindi nagpapabilis ng erosion ang mangroves.

paragraphs.label: Constitutional and Legal Principles:
paragraphs.text: Article II, Section 16 protects the right of the people to a balanced and healthful ecology. The writ of kalikasan is available when environmental damage affects the inhabitants of two or more cities or provinces. In Oposa v. Factoran, the Supreme Court recognized the standing of present generations to sue on behalf of future generations. June is Philippine Environment Month.

ai.title: Constitutional and Legal Principles
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mga prinsipyong legal tungkol sa kalikasan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Art II Sec 16; writ of kalikasan; Oposa v. Factoran; Hunyo = Environment Month.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang Earth Day ay April 22, hindi Environment Month.
